interpretation: The audit found credible source routes and several secondary instrument candidates, but no case has independently verified exact security-period coverage without authenticated access or a controlled data request. Therefore no case is classified as fully available.

official_sources.name: SETSMART FAQ
official_sources.evidence: SETSMART provides historical daily security price/statistics, supports start/end dates, and has authenticated Excel/API access; public documentation does not establish every predecessor security's exact coverage.

official_sources.name: SET SMART Marketplace
official_sources.evidence: SET describes API access to equity EOD trading price and statistics plus reference/corporate-action data.

official_sources.name: SET historical data route
official_sources.evidence: Repository audit identifies this as the official request/licensed-delivery route; exact product schema and period coverage require confirmation.

secondary_sources.name: EODHD EOD API
secondary_sources.evidence: EODHD documents daily Open, High, Low, Close, adjusted close, and Volume via authenticated API; free access is limited to the past year and paid plans provide deeper history.

secondary_sources.name: EODHD Thailand exchange
secondary_sources.evidence: EODHD identifies Thailand Exchange code BK/MIC XBKK and lists active tickers.

secondary_sources.name: EODHD instrument pages
secondary_sources.evidence: Public pages confirm provider instruments for BLA, IRPC, and INTUCH and advertise paid EOD access, but do not prove earliest coverage for each required period.
